reports.title: Probabilistic Guardplane and Observability-On Publication Policy
reports.research_claim: Telemetry-cost-aware claim publication stays auditable, replayable, and fail-closed when calibration quality degrades.
reports.negative_result_surface: Suppress publishable claims when observability evidence is missing, unstable, or green only under observability-off cells.

reports.title: Security Enforcement Verification Pack
reports.research_claim: Capability denials, IFC enforcement, and containment escalation remain adversarially testable with deterministic replay evidence.
reports.negative_result_surface: The report lane stays red when adversarial scenarios uncover silent bypasses, degraded-mode gaps, or missing replay artifacts.

reports.title: Runtime Semantics Verification Pack
reports.research_claim: Native runtime behavior is pinned through deterministic unit, integration, and replay-linked end-to-end evidence.
reports.negative_result_surface: The report lane fails closed when runtime semantics drift, error-path replay diverges, or required structured evidence is incomplete.

reports.title: Extension-Heavy Benchmark Methodology and Peer Comparison
reports.research_claim: FrankenEngine benchmark claims are tied to a neutral, artifact-backed methodology that remains reproducible against Node and Bun peers.
reports.negative_result_surface: The report lane must record blocked publication, missing peer evidence, and below-threshold outcomes instead of silently hiding losing or inconclusive runs.
